'''John Hawkins'''<ref name="dt-16957">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/16957 Yuck  Wookie breath     AKA speed deal], DeckTech (John "dashrendar" Hawkins, 24 June 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/16957/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/16957/ GitHub Pages].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''dashrendar''') posted a [[Dark Side|Dark]] [[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time]] list on DeckTech in June 2001. He won the [[2005 Endor Regional]] in Eugene, Oregon, on 23 October 2004 undefeated; he and runner-up [[James Sheldon]] both received byes into Day 2 of the [[2005 World Championship]], skipped the Final Confrontation and agreed to share the first-place prize by designing a virtual card together.<ref name="pcf-3974-55367">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55367#55367 From Rebels to Mavericks: 2005 Endor Regional Weekend], David Kangas, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (25 October 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050224204234/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55343%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> He played two decks without a single Virtual card.<ref name="pcf-3974-55369">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55369#55369 From Rebels to Mavericks: 2005 Endor Regional Weekend], Edward Fones, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (25 October 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050224204234/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55343%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
